Is Hasan Piker the Joe Rogan of the left?


What Now? with Trevor Noah (@WhatNowPodcast)

“The left needs a Joe Rogan.”
People have been saying that for years.

So what happens when Hasan Piker gets asked directly if he’s that person?

One of the most interesting parts of the episode.

Watch the full conversation now on YouTube.

— https://nitter.net/WhatNowPodcast/status/2060428207267197040#m

The internet has taught me that the moment someone says “that’s going to be clipped,” it’s already too late. 😂

Watch the full conversation on my YouTube channel now!

Really fascinating conversation. 

Full episode is up now on my YouTube channel.
